tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Searches the whole publication at once and says what kind each hit is: news articles, First Light items, entity records, projects, source documents and tracker pages. This is the broad search — prefer it when the question is not already about one kind of thing, because search_articles and the other

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Full-text search of published GMM news articles (title, summary, body), newest first, with an optional desk (section slug) and date range. Partner content is excluded. Matching is the content store's: the words are matched as whole-word prefixes and accents count, so "Male" does NOT find "Malé". For

tools.name: list_recent_articles
tools.description: The newest published GMM news articles, optionally from one desk (section slug). Partner content is excluded. Paginates: when more results remain, the structured answer has a nextCursor (absent on the last page). To continue, call this tool again with the same arguments and cursor set to that value.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: The full text of one published article as markdown, with headline, byline, key takeaways and references, ending in its canonical URL. Partner content is returned labelled as partner content, not GMM journalism.

tools.name: get_page_markdown
tools.description: Reads any public GMM page as clean markdown, the same text the site serves at the page address with .md appended. Use it to follow a link from another result: /news/<slug>, /partner/<slug>, /briefs/<YYYY-MM-DD>, /entities (index) and /entities/<slug> (a researched dossier), /documents and /documents

tools.name: get_first_light
tools.description: One edition of First Light, the daily morning brief, as markdown: its key number and numbered snippets with links. Omit date for the latest published edition. Only editions already released to readers are available.

tools.name: list_first_light
tools.description: The archive of published First Light morning briefs, newest first, with each edition date, title and snippet count. Paginates: when more results remain, the structured answer has a nextCursor (absent on the last page). To continue, call this tool again with the same arguments and cursor set to that

tools.name: list_entity_categories
tools.description: The categories GMM files its entity records under — people, companies, institutions, places and the rest — with each one's slug and how many records it holds. Read this first when you want to narrow a search: the slug is what the `type` argument of list_entities and search_entities takes.

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Searches GMM's researched entity records (people, companies, institutions, places) by name, role or summary. Open a match with get_entity_record. Filter by type slug. Matching is the content store's substring match and accents count, so "Male" does not find "Malé"; search_site folds accents and sear

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: The index of GMM entity records, grouped by category (people, companies, institutions, places), optionally limited to one category slug — list_entity_categories has the slugs. Each record has a canonical URL, and says whether it carries a graded dossier. Paginates: when more results remain, the stru

tools.name: get_entity_record
tools.description: GMM's researched record of one entity: the dossier as markdown, plus the full record as structured data. Each fact carries a #fact-<id> anchor (cite as <canonical URL>#fact-<id>) and a grade, and the record has a recordRevision; cite both per the guide at /about/citing-gmm. This is GMM's own graded

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Searches primary-source documents (laws, budgets, contracts, reports) by title, summary or reference. Open a match with get_document. Matching is the content store's substring match and accents count; search_site folds accents and searches every kind at once. Paginates: when more results remain, the

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: The independent source library, newest first. Company-supplied documents are not listed here. Paginates: when more results remain, the structured answer has a nextCursor (absent on the last page). To continue, call this tool again with the same arguments and cursor set to that value.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: One primary-source document: issuer, reference, dates, GMM plain-language summary, the file link and the news coverage that cites it, as markdown ending in its canonical URL.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: GMM project tracker: public projects with status, value, employer and contractor, newest first. Optionally one status, e.g. under-construction or delayed. tools.name: get_project
tools.description: One tracked project: parties, value, financing, status against schedule, variations, documents and coverage, as markdown ending in its canonical URL.

tools.name: list_tracker_series
tools.description: The economy tracker's catalogue: Maldives Monetary Authority statistical series grouped by theme, each with its latest figure and year-on-year change. Open one with get_tracker_series. Says so plainly if the tracker database is unavailable. Paginates: when more results remain, the structured answer

tools.name: get_tracker_series
tools.description: One economy tracker series: unit, frequency, source, the revision versions MMA has published and the latest observations. Says so plainly if the tracker database is unavailable.

tools.name: list_indicators
tools.description: The indicators GMM charts in its articles and dashboards (tourism, fiscal, trade, state-owned enterprises), each with its unit, source note and the latest 24 observations. Pages are at /dashboard. Paginates: when more results remain, the structured answer has a nextCursor (absent on the last page).
